bio_en: Mariam Makarian, known as Maro, was born in 1872 in one of the seaside towns of the Caucasus and lost her parents in childhood. Against the wishes of her relatives she left home after her studies to work as an Armenian teacher in a remote district bordering Turkey, among the young Caucasian women who went to teach in Tabriz and Persia in the 1890s. There, besides her teaching, she devoted herself to revolutionary work for the liberation of the homeland. She died young, mourned in Droshak in February 1897 as a 'heroic girl'.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death c. late 1896 - early 1897 (Droshak 22 Feb 1897). See #402 'Karo and Maro'.
